items.html: And it is known that the legs of Arich Anpin end at the end of the world of Atzilut, so that those two lower joints of Netzah-Hod of Atik are found in the world of Beria, revealed without any garment. These joined together and clothed in the Malchut of Arich Anpin, and there they became two breasts for her, on her two sides. These are the secret of the breasts of the animal, which are below at the legs, and from them the Kings who descended into Beria nursed, before they were corrected in their place — in Arich Anpin, in AVI, and in ZON. And also, after every Partzuf was born, they would first descend there and nurse from them, and afterward rise to their place, as above.
